documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Management stated that JG Chemicals delivered its best ever quarterly performance in Q2 FY27, with revenue, EBITDA, and PAT scaling new quarterly highs driven by healthy demand and a favorable product mix. The company's expansion projects, including the Dahej greenfield facility and Naidupeta brownfield expansion, are progressing towards commissioning to support future demand through FY28 and FY29. Management highlighted their positioning as India's largest zinc recycling company and a leading manufacturer of value-added green zinc oxide. Furthermore, the company maintains a strong financial position with a net cash surplus and expects margins to expand towards 14% to 15% over the next 3 years. J.G.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to reach closer to 14% to 15% in the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% with higher-value product offerings.
guidance.quote: Margins as our CFO just mentioned, it would be approximately close to 14% EBITDA because stronger products are being developed, and over the last quarter, we've also invested, as we said, and come out with one or two new products, and another product is also on the anvil in which we are expecting the patent to come very soon.

guidance.claim: Utilization at the Dahej plant is expected to be between 50% and 60% in the first full financial year of operations.
guidance.quote: So, I just mentioned in the previous question that in FY28, we expect a utilization of 50% to 60% minimum, and the following year, we expect to be in the in the 70s range, and by then we would start the expansion of Phase 2.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: Volume growth was in double digits for the current quarter across categories.
guidance.quote: And the volume growth was in double digits for the current quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand across all customer end-user applications in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-rubber applications accounted for over 18% of sales in the first half of 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Non-rubber applications today account for over 18% of our sales in the first half of 2027, supported by expansion across ceramic, specialty chemicals, agriculture and pharmaceutical verticals.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27 supported by festive demand and significant volume growth across vehicle categories.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately 25000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories like passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, and three-wheelers.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is on track for commissioning in Q4 of '27 and is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons.
capex_expansion.quote: At Naidupeta, our brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in the Q4 of '27. The project is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons to our existing manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Together, the Dahej and Naidupeta expansions are expected to increase total zinc oxide capacity to approximately 79,900 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with Dahej and Naidupeta expansions are expected to increase our total zinc oxide capacity to approximately 79,900 tons per annum, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and '29.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Private Limited acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta during 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our long-term expansion plan, JG, through its material subsidiary, BDJ Oxides Private Limited, acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District, Andhra during 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Subsidiary BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026 to support future capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is incorporating BDJ Materials and Metals Trading FZCO, Dubai, as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary to diversify zinc raw material sourcing.
capex_expansion.quote: To further strengthen its international presence, JGC is incorporating BDJ Materials and Metals Trading FZCO, Dubai, as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary. This will provide a dedicated international base to diversify zinc raw material sourcing and support global sales and distribution of finished products.

capex_expansion.claim: The Gujarat project in Dahej is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility has an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc greenfield chemical facility will add 40,000 plus MTA capacity, with Phase 1 adding 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and the EBITDA margins that we expect to generate from that project would be in the 11% to 12% range.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta debottlenecking adds about 5,000 tons of capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the total capacity being added is about 5,000 tons.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 10.71%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR38.65 crores, up 77% year-on-year and 7% sequentially with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of the year, EBITDA margin stood at 11.07%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was at INR74.9 crores, up 66% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of the year, PAT margin stood at 7.99%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT margin for the half year ended was 7.99%.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71 percent in Q2 FY27, which improved 79 bps year-on-year from 9.92 percent.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company's pricing model enables the pass-through of zinc price movements to help mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 percent, improving 92 bps year-on-year from 6.82 percent.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 was INR315.7 crores with EBITDA of INR36.3 crores and margin of 11.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is neutral to zinc price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly. So, whether zinc is at 3,000 or 3,500 or 3,600, it really doesn't matter to us.

orders_capacity.claim: JGC has an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% during Q2.
orders_capacity.quote: On the operational front, the company continued to deliver double-digit volume growth during Q2 with zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.
orders_capacity.quote: We have installed a capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeded 80 percent with further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

orders_capacity.claim: Together, total zinc oxide capacity will increase to 79904 MTPA upon commissioning of upcoming expansions.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity across West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as of 30th September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We have a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as per 30th September 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted West Asia disruptions as part of the operating environment context for tyre exports.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach an EBITDA margin closer to 14% to 15% in 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the Dahej facility is planned to start in the 2028 calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: Company's commitment -- so Phase 2 of the Dahej would start sometime in 2028 calendar year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues to close to 30% over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So I think in the next 2 to 3 years, we should be at a level close to 30% and on the margin front, this will definitely act as a contributor in pushing up the EBITDA margins to the 14% to 15% range that we have targeted.

management_commitments.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej plant is targeted for commissioning in November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

management_commitments.claim: Utilization at Dahej is expected to reach a minimum of 50% to 60% in the first full financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I just mentioned in the previous question that in FY28, we expect a utilization of 50% to 60% minimum, and the following year, we expect to be in the in the 70s range, and by then we would start the expansion of Phase 2.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
